result.summary: Found 1 visually broken layout issue: the bottom restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed navigation bar, making the content look clipped and harder to interact with.

issues.description: The second card under "Popular right now" is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, so its content is not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/inset to the scrolling content or adjust the fixed nav bar so the last list item can scroll fully above it.
